description: Delete an object in a namespace (the delete verb of Media's namespace grants, WS-G task 2): a soft delete that keeps the bytes for the retention period, and the restore that undoes it within that period (checked against the namespace's quotas); refused while the object is under a retention hold. The same verb guards the v1 file delete (DELETE /api/v1/:app/files/:key). media.object.upload also grants it, for tokens issued before the verbs were split, unless the namespace's policy is strict_verbs.
